comparison.objective: Orient and load a butane canister against a seal while operating its locking lever; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: In-hand canister rotation, guided insertion against spring force, sustained seating, and lever actuation versus concentric screw/nut tool use and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires notch-up alignment, nozzle home, lever at least 3.5 cm across, stillness, and burner protection; candidate requires angular stop accuracy retained across three cycles.
comparison.reason: Although both require one hand to preserve a setting while the other locks, this record preserves a canister's seated pose with a separate lever rather than counterholding a threaded adjustment against jam-nut torque.
